title: A CHARGED-OFF non-fraud loan credits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY for a buy-down fee amortization (loan 5 L322: CREDIT account 18 16.48, DEBIT account 22 16.48)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that IS CHARGED OFF and NOT fraud, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES) at the amortization transaction L322. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 322 (type loanTransactionType.buyDownFeeAmortization): interestPortion 16.48 -> "1648" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan read-back carries a NON-REVERSED chargeOff transaction id 321 dated 2024-03-01 with a LOWER id than the amortization (both are dated 2024-03-01, so the id order decides), the charge-off request carries NO reason, and the loan's fraud flag is false, so request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.charged_off is true and fraud / written_off are absent. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES.json: incomeFromBuyDownAccountId 24, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, writeOffAccountId 15, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 16. expect.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L322 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 656 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 18 amount 16.48 and id 657 DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 16.48. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a charged-off non-fraud loan's amortization credits CHARGE_OFF_EXPENSE (18), not income from buy down (24) and not the fraud account, and debits the same total to deferred income liability. It is the account cell that discriminates the ignore-loan-state drive. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the FRAUD branch (the loan is not fraud), a positive fee portion (zero here), the written-off arm, and the buy-down-fee CLASSIFICATION and charge-off-REASON branches (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
